calculation.description: Ranks assets by drawdown severity from their 120-session rolling high, scaled by the square root of consecutive sessions underwater. Positive values indicate larger drawdown severity per duration and are interpreted as rebound candidates. Signal is lagged one completed trading day.

parameters.duration_definition: consecutive completed sessions with close below rolling 120-day high

validation.regime_notes: 60D IC was +0.082895 (2020-23, 357 dates), +0.053986 (2024-26, 373), +0.076442 (2027-29, 782), +0.110036 (2030-32, 784), and +0.056900 (2033-35, 483). Positive in every evaluated regime; uncertainty remains material for the 15-instrument cross-section.

provenance.max_abs_library_correlation_note: Pending deterministic audit from signal artifacts; null is not treated as zero.
